name: SWPS University
summary: Private university with campuses in six Polish cities; English bachelor's in psychology on four, plus design, computing, English and management.

ib.text: No entrance exam and no NAWA statement for an IB Diploma: send it with proof of B2 English (an IB taken in English counts). Design adds a portfolio interview.

dates.label: Admissions close (earlier for a programme once its places fill)

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Cognition, emotion, personality, social and developmental psychology and psychopathology, with methods, statistics and psychometrics, taught to the EuroPsy standard; at least one project course each year and courses on clinical, school and organisational psychology.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission: documents plus B2 English (an IB taken in English counts); places go in order of completed applications until the limit fills.

family.name: Psychology
family.differs: Warsaw campus in the Praga district; €7,400 a year.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Cognition, emotion, personality, social and developmental psychology and psychopathology, with methods, statistics and psychometrics on the Kraków campus; clinical, school and work applications and a project course every year.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission: documents plus B2 English (an IB taken in English counts); places go in order of completed applications until the limit fills.

family.name: Psychology
family.differs: Kraków campus; same curriculum and fee (€7,400 a year).

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Emotion, motivation, cognition, personality and individual differences, social psychology, and psychology in education, work and healthcare, with supervised work in behavioural research labs on the Wrocław campus.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission: documents plus B2 English (an IB taken in English counts); places go in order of completed applications until the limit fills.

family.name: Psychology
family.differs: Wrocław campus in a renovated industrial building; €7,400 a year.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Cognition, emotion, personality, social and developmental psychology and psychopathology, with methods, statistics and psychometrics on the seaside Sopot campus in the Tri-City; clinical, school and work applications and a project course every year.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission: documents plus B2 English (an IB taken in English counts); places go in order of completed applications until the limit fills.

family.name: Psychology
family.differs: Sopot campus by the Baltic; same curriculum and fee (€7,400 a year).

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Algorithms, data structures and maths with coding in Python, Java and JavaScript, then a track in cybersecurity or AI and machine learning; a practical degree with projects, internships and some psychology and social science.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission: documents plus B2 English (an IB taken in English counts); places go in order of completed applications until the limit fills.

programmes.name: Design
programmes.about: School of Form's design degree: a shared first year of 2D and 3D design and hands-on workshop craft, then a specialisation in Message (communication), Object (product) or Space, ending with a graduation project under two supervisors.
programmes.ib: A portfolio (up to 20 pages) and an online interview in English about it; 50 of 80 points to be recommended.
programmes.selectionNote: Upload documents and portfolio, then a remote portfolio interview on set dates; pass with 50 of 80, then places go in order until full.

programmes.name: English Studies
programmes.about: Practical English to C1, linguistics, phonetics, and British and American literature and culture, with academic writing and translation tools; from the end of year one a study track such as teaching English (TEFL) or translation.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission: documents plus B2 English (an IB taken in English counts); places go in order of completed applications until the limit fills.

programmes.name: English Studies with Additional Language
programmes.about: The English Studies core (C1 English, linguistics, literature, academic writing) plus a second language taken to at least B2: Chinese, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean or Spanish. Some language pairs fill early.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission: documents plus B2 English (an IB taken in English counts); places go in order of completed applications until the limit fills.

separateFrom.name: English Studies
separateFrom.reason: A separate programme with its own fee and a second language studied throughout; places are counted per language pair, and some pairs close before others.

programmes.name: Management and Leadership
programmes.about: Hands-on management: teams and projects, leadership, business plans, economics and accounting, social innovation and data-driven decisions, with 960 hours of internships and a body of professional work in place of a thesis.
programmes.selectionNote: Open admission: documents plus B2 English (an IB taken in English counts); places go in order of completed applications until the limit fills.

notes: Tuition is one price for everyone, Polish or not, set per programme: from €4,600 (Management and Leadership) to €7,900 (Design) a year in 2026/27.
Places go in order until each programme is full, and some fill early: Management and Leadership moved to a waiting list in the last cycle, so apply soon after admissions open.
SWPS confirms its final 2027/28 programme list before admissions open, and a programme starts only if at least 18 students enrol.
